claims.claim: Added one read-only consult_flow interface supporting exactly the four specified flows, disabled by default with explicit Human opt-out. Advice preserves existing Human, Brain, audit-policy and final-family authoring boundaries.
Consultation binds caller-selected flow, canonical packet/source, sealed cut, candidate fingerprint and exact subject, including failed RUN/FAILURE/Executor or reviewed finding/SHA/required action.
The integration wraps existing CAA-02 B1 consultation and validation, retaining its 0–3 recommendations, citations, counterexamples, epistemic limits, falsifiers and finite outcomes.

Mapping and JSON transports share a strict versioned envelope and binding validation. Deterministic four-flow fixtures cover equivalent requests, malformed responses, budgets, attribution, substitution and injection.

Optional absence, opt-out and transport failure produce bounded abstention without retries or mutation. Mandatory canonical guards run independently before and after consultation; existing sealed historical reads and post-transport cut reauthentication are reused.

The commit changes exactly six permitted paths, records CAA-03 as sole NEXT, preserves prior planning and lineage, leaves CAA-04/05 unselected, and binds unchanged strict CAA-02 historical assertions to their exact reviewed snapshot. Existing policy and lifecycle source files remain unchanged.
